Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

    A=[r[:] for r in I]; H=len(A); W=len(A[0])
    # row gaps: fill zero cells between same-color runs
    for r in range(H):
        c=0
        while c<W:
            if A[r][c]==0:
                # find next nonzero
                j=c+1
                while j<W and A[r][j]==0: j+=1
                if j==W: continue
                k=j
                while k+1<W and A[r][k+1]==A[r][j] and A[r][k+1]!=0: k+=1
                if k>j and A[r][j]!=0 and A[r][k]!=0 and A[r][j]==A[r][k]:
                    for x in range(c+1,k): A[r][x]=A[r][j]
                c=j+1
            else: c+=1
    # column gaps: fill with nearest below
    for c in range(W):
        for r in range(H-1,-1,-1):
            below=next((rr for rr in range(r+1,H) if A[rr][c]!=0), None)
            if below is not None:
                v=A[below][c]
                # only if cell above chain is zero and continues upward until a nonzero
                rr=r
                while rr>H-1 or True:
                    break
                # fill upward while zeros, stopping at next nonzero
                rr=r
                while rr>0 and A[rr-1][c]==0:
                    rr-=1
                if rr<H and A[rr][c]!=0: pass
                # simple: fill contiguous zero block below the topmost... redo cleanly:
                break
    return A

    import numpy as np
    A=np.array(I); H,W=A.shape
    # internal gap fill per color per row
    B=A.copy()
    for v in np.unique(A[A!=0].flatten()):
        mask=(A==v)
        for r in range(H):
            cs=[c for c in range(W) if mask[r,c]]
            lo,hi=min(cs),max(cs)
            for c in range(lo,hi+1):
                if B[r,c]==0: B[r,c]=v
    # find holes: zero flanked by same v on both sides
    holes={}
    for v in np.unique(A[A!=0].flatten()):
        for r in range(H):
            for c in range(1,W-1):
                if A[r,c]==0 and A[r,c-1]==v and A[r,c+1]==v:
                    holes.setdefault(v,[]).append((r,c))
    # groups: per (row,color) connected spans after gap-fill; compute special col per group
    res=B.copy()
    # process in reading order of (row, then color)
    import itertools
    order=sorted(set(zip(range(H),range(1,W))),...)
    # easier: iterate rows 0..H-1, for each row collect colors present
    leg_bottom={c:-1 for c in range(W)}
    for r in range(H):
        rowcolors=sorted(set(A[r,A[r]!=0].flatten().tolist()))
        for v in rowcolors:
            cs=[c for c in range(W) if A[r,c]==v]
            lo,hi=min(cs),max(cs)
            # span = lo..hi after gap fill (internal zeros already filled in B, but original A tells span)
            # special col: hole in this row for this color
            sp_col=None
            for c in range(lo,hi+1):
                if A[r,c]==0 and A[r,c-1]==v and A[r,c+1]==v:
                    sp_col=c
            # horizontal arm: paint span; if sp_col outside [lo,hi], extend to edge
            for c in range(lo,hi+1):
                if res[r,c]==0: res[r,c]=v
            if sp_col is not None and (sp_col<lo or sp_col>hi):
                rng=range(hi+1,W) if sp_col>hi else range(0,lo)
                for c in rng:
                    if res[r,c]==0: res[r,c]=v
            # vertical leg
            if sp_col is not None:
                start=leg_bottom[sp_col]+1
                for rr in range(start,r+1):
                    if res[rr,sp_col]==0: res[rr,sp_col]=v
                leg_bottom[sp_col]=r
    # isolated cells: single-cell runs not flanked by zeros of same color... define: cell with no same-color neighbor horizontally AND no hole situation? Use: cells whose color has no hole in their row and run length 1
    for r in range(H):
        rowcells=[(c,int(A[r,c])) for c in range(W) if A[r,c]!=0]
        for (c,v) in rowcells:
            nb_left = A[r,c-1]==v if c>0 else False
            nb_right = A[r,c+1]==v if c<W-1 else False
            # skip if part of a multi-cell run or a hole-owner row
            if nb_left or nb_right: continue
            # special col = own column
            sp_col=c
            start=leg_bottom[sp_col]+1
            for rr in range(start,r+1):
                if res[rr,sp_col]==0: res[rr,sp_col]=v
            leg_bottom[sp_col]=r
